segments.sn7.2:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe.
segments.sn7.2:2.1: “bhāradvājagotto kira brāhmaṇo samaṇassa gotamassa santike agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito”ti kupito anattamano yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ asabbhāhi pharusāhi vācāhi akkosati paribhāsati. Evaṃ vutte, bhagavā akkosakabhāradvājaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn7.2:2.3: api nu kho te āgacchanti mittāmaccā ñātisālohitā atithiyo [atithayo (?)]”ti?
segments.sn7.2:2.4: “Appekadā me, bho gotama, āgacchanti mittāmaccā ñātisālohitā atithiyo”ti.
segments.sn7.2:2.5: “‘Taṃ kiṃ maññasi, brāhmaṇa, api nu tesaṃ anuppadesi khādanīyaṃ vā bhojanīyaṃ vā sāyanīyaṃ vā’”ti?
segments.sn7.2:2.6: “‘Appekadā nesāhaṃ, bho gotama, anuppademi khādanīyaṃ vā bhojanīyaṃ vā sāyanīyaṃ vā’”ti.
segments.sn7.2:2.7: “‘Sace kho pana te, brāhmaṇa, nappaṭiggaṇhanti, kassa taṃ hotī’”ti?
segments.sn7.2:2.8: “‘Sace te, bho gotama, nappaṭiggaṇhanti, amhākameva taṃ hotī’”ti.
segments.sn7.2:2.9: “Evameva kho, brāhmaṇa, yaṃ tvaṃ amhe anakkosante akkosasi, arosente rosesi, abhaṇḍante bhaṇḍasi, taṃ te mayaṃ nappaṭiggaṇhāma.
segments.sn7.2:3.1: “Yo kho, brāhmaṇa, akkosantaṃ paccakkosati, rosentaṃ paṭiroseti, bhaṇḍantaṃ paṭibhaṇḍati, ayaṃ vuccati, brāhmaṇa, sambhuñjati vītiharatīti.
segments.sn7.2:3.2: Te mayaṃ tayā neva sambhuñjāma na vītiharāma.
segments.sn7.2:3.5: “Bhavantaṃ kho gotamaṃ sarājikā parisā evaṃ jānāti –
segments.sn7.2:3.7: Atha ca pana bhavaṃ gotamo kujjhatī”ti.
segments.sn7.2:8.1: Evaṃ vutte, akkosakabhāradvājo brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn7.2:8.3: esāhaṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañca bhikkhusaṅghañca.
segments.sn7.2:8.4: Labheyyāhaṃ, bhante, bhoto gotamassa santike pabbajjaṃ, labheyyaṃ upasampadan”ti.
segments.sn7.2:9.1: Alattha kho akkosakabhāradvājo brāhmaṇo bhagavato santike pabbajjaṃ, alattha upasampadaṃ.
segments.sn7.2:9.2: Acirūpasampanno kho panāyasmā akkosakabhāradvājo eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto nacirasseva – yassatthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti tadanuttaraṃ – brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihāsi.
segments.sn7.2:9.3: “Khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyā”ti abbhaññāsi.
segments.sn7.2:9.4: Aññataro ca panāyasmā bhāradvājo arahataṃ ahosīti.

lines: Dutiye akkosakabhāradvājoti bhāradvājova so, pañcamattehi pana gāthā satehi tathāgataṃ akkosanto āgatoti.
Kupito anattamanoti “samaṇena gotamena mayhaṃ jeṭṭhakabhātaraṃ pabbājentena jāni katā, pakkho bhinno”ti kodhena kupito domanassena ca anattamano hutvāti attho.
Akkosatīti “corosi, bālosi, mūḷhosi, thenosi, oṭṭhosi, meṇḍosi, goṇosi, gadrabhosi, tiracchānagatosi, nerayikosī”ti dasahi akkosavatthūhi akkosati.
Paribhāsatīti “hotu muṇḍakasamaṇaka,‘adaṇḍo ahan’ti karosi, idāni te rājakulaṃ gantvā daṇḍaṃ āropessāmī”tiādīni vadanto paribhāsati nāma.
“Isayo nāma kupitā sapanaṃ denti kisavacchādayo viyā”ti anussavavasena “sapati maṃ maññe samaṇo gotamo”ti bhayaṃ uppajji.
Tasseva tena pāpiyoti tasseva puggalassa tena kodhena pāpaṃ hoti.
Yo puggalo sato upasammati, ubhinnamatthaṃ carati tikicchati sādheti, taṃ puggalaṃ janā bāloti maññanti.
Vītiharatīti byatihāraṃ karoti, akkosato paccakkosanādinā vinimayaṃ karotīti attho.
Assa anussavavasena sutvā “sapati man”ti saññino bhayaṃ uppajjīti yojanā.
Sutvāti padaṃ ubhayatthāpi yojetabbaṃ “tavevetaṃ brāhmaṇāti sutvā, anussavavasena sutvā”ti ca.
Kāmaṃ kisavacchādayo sapanaṃ nādaṃsu, devatānaṃyeva hi so attho, sattānaṃ pana tathā saññā uppannā, sopi tathāsaññī ahosi.
Tassevāti paṭikujjhantasseva puggalassa tena kodhena pāpaṃ hoti pāpassa santānantarasaṅkantiyā abhāvato.
Keci pana “tassevāti tasseva paṭikujjhantapurisassa tena paṭikujjhanena.
Satiyā samannāgato hutvā paṭisaṅkhāne ṭhito adhivāseti, na saho mūḷho hutvāti adhippāyo.
Ubhinnaṃ tikicchantanti ubhinnaṃ uppannakodhasaṅkhātaṃ kilesabyādhiṃ tikicchantaṃ vūpasamentaṃ taṃ puggalaṃ.
Yo puggalotiādinā purimāsu gāthāsu pavattitāni padāni sambandhitvā dasseti.
Pañcasu khandhesu yāthāvato vinītā ariyadhammassa kovidā nāma hontīti āha “dhammassāti pañcakkhandhadhammassā”ti.
Idāni tamatthaṃ paripuṇṇaṃ katvā dassento āha “catusaccadhammassa vā”ti.
Gāmanigamaraṭṭhapūjitoti iminā gāmanigamaraṭṭhasāmikehi pūjitabhāvo dīpito gāmādīnaṃ tesaṃ vase vattanato.
Sesanti abhikkantantiādi, yampi caññaṃ idhāgataṃ heṭṭhā vaṇṇitañca.
Bhāradvājova soti bhāradvājo nāma eva so brāhmaṇo.
Gottavasena hi tayidaṃ nāmaṃ, visesena panetaṃ jātanti dassetuṃ “pañcamattehī”tiādi vuttaṃ.
Yathā domanassito anattamanoti vattabbaṃ labhati, evaṃ kupitoti āha “domanassena cā”ti.
Dasahīti anavasesapariyādānavasena vuttaṃ pañcahi gāthāsatehi akkosanto tathā akkoseyyāti katvā.
Tattha pana yena kenaci akkosantopi akkosatiyeva nāma.
